text:
[issue by Kres-sou]
Im trying to run the newest version of geckolib on 1.21.1. neoforge for the mod Create: Pantographs and wires as it needs the 4.8.4 version. 

But on this version, it will crash modrinth at startup instantly. Tried lower version owo-lib (as it was on the newest one) that didn't help, as other mods need it and newest.

[comment by Tslat (collaborator)]
provide the crash report. Nothing I can do without it

[comment by Kres-sou (none)]
https://mclo.gs/hEmrFLV

[comment by Tslat (collaborator)]
There's no crash there

[comment by Kres-sou (none)]
The modrinth doesnt even recognize it as crash. I press play, nothing happends for 2-10 seconds, then stop button is changed for play.

[comment by Tslat (collaborator)]
Try it in prismlauncher instead

[comment by Kres-sou (none)]
[message.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26908369/message.txt) did not work either

[comment by Tslat (collaborator)]
Not sure then

This isn't a known issue with geckolib

Have you reported it to owo lib?

[comment by Kres-sou (none)]
Did just now, i'll see what they came up with

[comment by Witixin1512 (contributor)]
Using MultiMC and Neoforge 21.1.233

create-1.21.1-6.0.10.jar
dragonlib-neoforge-1.21.1-beta-3.0.28.jar
geckolib-neoforge-1.21.1-4.8.4.jar
jei-1.21.1-neoforge-19.27.0.340.jar
owo-lib-neoforge-0.12.15.5-beta.1+1.21.jar
pantographsandwires-neoforge-1.21.1-beta-0.2.3-C6.jar


I can launch just fine with no errors, get to the main menu, etc. My recommendation would be you binary search your pack, start with this bunch of mods, and slowly add mods in packs until you can replicate the issue and isolate the minimum required mods to have this.
